blocks.content: The morphological box (Zwicky) decomposes a solution into independent parameters, collects alternative options per parameter and combines one option per parameter into a whole concept.
A sub-function or property of the solution, such as "drive" or "vehicle". Every row of the box is a parameter.
A concrete alternative for a parameter. The options of one parameter exclude each other.
The consistency matrix marks pairs of options from different parameters as incompatible (cross-consistency assessment after Ritchey). The module counts all combinations and all consistent ones.
A path through the box: one chosen option per parameter. Concepts show as coloured dots in the cells; a concept with an incompatible pair is flagged.
The concepts are candidates for the subsequent solution selection. Nothing is scored or weighted here.

items: Use "+" below the box to create the sub-functions of the solution and name them.
Enter the options per parameter; "+" at the row end adds another one.
In the "Consistency" view, mark the pairs that do not fit together.
Use "+" below the concept list to create a concept and pick one option per parameter in the box.
Check in the concept list whether each concept is complete and free of conflicts.
